title: Dimensions for piston rods and butts for pneumatic rammer tools
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12523) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Dimensions for piston rods and butts for pneumatic rammer tools.
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions for piston rods and butts for pneumatic rammer tools

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
